name: contentful-backup-system
description: Event-driven Contentful backup system for AWS Amplify-hosted apps

scripts.scan:cfn: cfn-guard validate --data infrastructure/template.yaml --rules infrastructure/cfn-guard.rules || checkov -f infrastructure/template.yaml

//dependencyNotes: Every dependency is held at its LATEST version, including breaking majors, so the project stays clean for future development. js-yaml 5 removed the `Type` constructor and `DEFAULT_SCHEMA.extend()`; tests/helpers/cfn-template.js was ported to the v5 defineScalarTag/defineSequenceTag/defineMappingTag + Schema API, and the port is proven by a test that parses infrastructure/template.yaml and deep-compares it against a snapshot of the pre-migration (v4) parse. fast-check 4 is a major rewrite; the property tests were verified against it.
